vio.configuration.title: %s Settings
vio.configuration.server.provider.toolti: LLM provider Vio uses to reply.
vio.configuration.server.default_access_: Access level for players without their own, set with /vio access.
vio.configuration.server.openai.model.to: Model ID for the OpenAI provider.
vio.configuration.server.anthropic.model: Model ID for the Anthropic provider.
vio.configuration.server.ollama.uri.tool: Chat endpoint of the Ollama server. Use 127.0.0.1 rather than localhost: Ollama listens on IPv4 only.
vio.configuration.server.ollama.model.to: Model ID for the Ollama provider.
vio.configuration.server.ollama.context_: Context window for the Ollama provider, in tokens. Must fit the instructions, tools and conversation plus the reply.
vio.configuration.server.voice.speech_to: Speech to text for voice requests.
vio.configuration.server.voice.text_to_s: Text to speech for spoken replies.
vio.configuration.server.voice.silence_s: Seconds of silence after speaking that end a voice request and send it.
vio.configuration.server.voice.max_captu: Longest a voice request can be, in seconds; it's sent when reached.
vio.configuration.server.voice.voicestud: VoiceStudio text to speech engine, e.g. omnivoice or kittentts. The first request after a change waits for it to load.
VoiceStudio voice profile ID or name, or default for the engine's default voice.
vio.configuration.server.voice.elevenlab: Voice ID for ElevenLabs text to speech.
Model ID for ElevenLabs speech to text.
Model ID for ElevenLabs text to speech.
Below this confidence in the detected language, speech is transcribed again as the player's game language.
Audio format requested from ElevenLabs, resampled to 48 kHz if needed.
vio.configuration.server.scripts.enabled: Whether FULL players can have Vio write and run Groovy scripts on the server. Scripts can do anything the server can, including reading and writing files. Takes effect on restart.
vio.configuration.server.scripts.run_bud: Longest a script run started by Vio can take, in milliseconds. One-shot scripts and periodic scripts run on demand.
vio.configuration.server.scripts.periodi: Longest a scheduled run of a periodic script can take, in milliseconds.
vio.configuration.server.scripts.listene: Longest one event handler call of a listener script can take, in milliseconds.
vio.configuration.server.scripts.command: Longest one execution of a script command can take, in milliseconds.
vio.configuration.server.scripts.max_fai: Consecutive failures, timeouts included, after which a script is disabled until it's enabled again or the server restarts.
vio.configuration.server.datapack.enable: Whether FULL players can have Vio write files into a data pack kept in the world's serverconfig/vio/datapack and reload it. Takes effect on restart; while it's off, the pack isn't loaded, but its files stay on disk.
vio.configuration.keys.openai.tooltip: OpenAI API key. Must be set if OpenAI is the provider.
vio.configuration.keys.anthropic.tooltip: Anthropic API key. Must be set if Anthropic is the provider.
vio.configuration.keys.elevenlabs.toolti: ElevenLabs API key. Must be set if ElevenLabs is used for speech to text or text to speech.
vio.configuration.keys.voicestudio.toolt: VoiceStudio API key. Only needed if VoiceStudio runs on another machine.
